description: Optional FP16/BF16 saved inverse factors; all inverse arithmetic and working scratch stay FP32.
tolerance: Per gradient: max(abs(kernel - FP32 golden)) <= 2*max(abs(reordered FP16 Torch - FP32 golden)) + 1e-5.

initial_native_screen.note: 45/45 passed and gradient max errors exactly matched the rounding screen. This screen preceded eliminating the redundant expanded-factor copy; the final implementation passed all 152 backward/reference tests.

timing_method: Synchronized wall time. Same inputs/caches in one process; rotate dtype order, 3 warmup + 15 measured samples per mode. Forward uses preallocated buffers; backward includes allocation and enqueue. No TP communication.
benchmark_script:
import json, statistics, time
import torch, torch_npu
from csrc.kernel.gdn_mega_bwd.backward import backward
from csrc.kernel.gdn_mega_bwd.binding import build
from test_gdn_mega import _prepare_gdn_mega, pto_gdn_mega

torch.npu.set_device(0)
torch.npu.config.allow_internal_format = False
native = build()
print(json.dumps({'device_library': native.device_library._name}), flush=True)

def measure(length, heads, key_heads):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    q = torch.randn(1,length,key_heads,128,device='npu',dtype=torch.float16)*.1
    k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn_like(q), dim=-1)
    v = torch.randn(1,length,heads,128,device='npu',dtype=torch.float16)
    g = -torch.rand(1,length,heads,device='npu')*.1
    beta, do = torch.rand_like(g).half(), torch.randn_like(v)
    cu = torch.tensor([0,length],device='npu',dtype=torch.int32)
    launch = _prepare_gdn_mega(q,k,v,g,beta,cu)
    gates = tuple(launch[x] for x in ('g_t','g_sum','beta_t'))
    caches = {str(dt).split('.')[-1]: torch.empty(length//128,heads,128,128,device='npu',dtype=dt)
              for dt in (torch.float32, torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)}
    pto_gdn_mega(**launch)
    reference = launch['out'].clone(), launch['final_state'].clone()
    for cache in caches.values():
        pto_gdn_mega(**launch,inverse_cache=cache)
        for name, expected in zip(('out','final_state'),reference):
            torch.testing.assert_close(launch[name],expected,atol=0,rtol=0)
    for name in ('float16','bfloat16'):
        torch.testing.assert_close(caches[name],caches['float32'].to(caches[name].dtype),atol=0,rtol=0)
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    samples = {}
    for direction in ('forward','backward'):
        modes = list(caches.items()) + ([('none',None)] if direction=='forward' else [])
        for trial in range(18):
            rotated = modes[trial%len(modes):] + modes[:trial%len(modes)]
            for name, cache in rotated:
                start = time.perf_counter()
                if direction=='forward': pto_gdn_mega(**launch,inverse_cache=cache)
                else: backward(q,k,v,g,beta,do,inverse_cache=cache,gate_cache=gates)
                torch.npu.synchronize()
                if trial>=3: samples.setdefault(direction+'_'+name,[]).append((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000)
    print(json.dumps(dict(tokens=length,heads=heads,key_heads=key_heads,samples_ms=samples,
        medians_ms={k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in samples.items()},
        inverse_bytes={k:v.numel()*v.element_size() for k,v in caches.items()})),flush=True)

for shape in ((2048,16,2),(8192,16,2),(8192,64,16),(32768,64,16)):
    measure(*shape)
